reviewFindings: The original S03 integration evidence retained pre-remediation hashes for the T02 and T03 review-fix manifests.
The license policy allowed unsupported OR, WITH, symbolic, mixed, or malformed expressions to reach permissive category fallback.
Taskctl could not resume capability-level remediation after every slice had already been independently approved.
resolution: A superseding S03 integration record binds the current canonical T02 and T03 review-fix bytes and leaves the original record untouched.
Unsupported compound license syntax is rejected before category fallback; strict AND is allowed only when every component is individually allowlisted.
Capability resume now recognizes only CHANGES_REQUESTED or BLOCKED capability-review remediation when no incomplete slice remains, with a regression test denying unrelated no-slice resumptions.
The frozen lxml dependency remains 6.1.1, above the advisory fixed boundary, with no vulnerability or license exception and no weakened threshold.
